title: But when this brief pride of silence upheld him no longer he was glad to find himself still in the midst of common lives, passing on his way amid the squalor and noise and sloth of the city fearlessly and with a light heart
html_source:
Notice how beautifully Joyce describes the process of thinking and revelation here that it’s practically worth noting just for that. Stephen’s philosophical journey are a series of intellectual transformations that impact him inwardly as well as outwardly. Stephen is finally able to reconcile his interior world with the outside world much better, and the everyday dissatisfaction of earlier chapters has vanished. We beared witness throughout the book to a boy evolve mentally as well as emotionally, we can’t help but relate it to our own lives as well.
This feeling of “We’ve been there” is also prominent in the movie
